name: Ff Review
description:
Plugin description

Code quality review plugin based on Frontend Fundamentals 4 principles (readability, predictability, cohesion, coupling). Supports React and Angular with framework-specific best practice examples. Reviews git diff, specific files, or PRs with prioritized findings (🔴🟡🟢), external dependency verification, and false positive handling.
longDescription:
Installs with `claude plugin install ff-review@claude-community` from `rrkkee015/frontend-fundamentals`.

Frontend Fundamentals (FF) is a growing collection of essential principles for building reliable, maintainable, and accessible frontend applications. It helps you answer common but tricky questions like how to judge code quality, why bundling behaves differently in dev vs. production, how screen readers interpret your UI, and how to debug efficiently.
